title: Your Retirement Calculator Is Lying — $847K Short
hook: You checked the calculator and it said you're on track — but it forgot four things that add up to an $847,000 gap.
angle: Free online retirement calculators systematically underestimate real retirement costs by omitting healthcare expenses, tax drag on 401k withdrawals, sequence-of-returns risk, and real vs. nominal inflation — giving millions a false green checkmark.
audience: Working adults 35–55 who've used a free online retirement calculator and felt confident about their retirement readiness
key_numbers: $315,000 average out-of-pocket healthcare costs per couple in retirement (Fidelity 2023)
22 cents of every pre-tax 401k dollar belongs to the IRS at withdrawal
Retiring one year before a market crash can drain a portfolio 15 years early
Healthcare inflation ran 6–8% per year for decades — cutting purchasing power in half every 11 years
